eva: Quick quarterly recap - I ran the recurrence extractor across postmortems and incident tags. Top recurring signals across Dedicated/Private: KV cold starts during model swaps, autoscaler oscillation on burst traffic, and brief cross-region packet retransmits. Posting counts + proposed owners.

li: Thanks. Counts? sample query?

eva: Window: 2025-09-01..2026-03-01. Counts: kv_cold=14, autoscaler_bounce=10, net_retransmit=6. Query: ```sql SELECT root_cause, count(*) FROM incidents WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2025-09-01' AND '2026-03-01' GROUP BY root_cause; ```

derek: Are KV issues concentrated by model family or session pattern?

eva: Mostly large-context families and sessions with rapid model rotation. Also some correlated spikes when we've pushed new model-weights to Dedicated pools.

ops-bot: ops-bot created INF-5120 for "kv cold starts - counters + mitigation"

li: Proposed owners: li -> KV counters & adaptive warmup (PoC 10d), derek -> autoscaler hysteresis + canary (7d), jun -> cross-region retry smoothing (8bd). Agree?

jun: I can own cross-region smoothing. Plan: add jittered retry backoff + per-route circuit breaker; canary to 5% then 25%. Target initial canary in 8 business days.

derek: Autoscaler plan: 30s smoothing window + rate-limited scale-down. I'll draft RFC and run perf jobs. Need perf-harness access. Target RFC in 5 working days.

li: For KV counters I'll add per-model_version+deployment shard and a kv.cold_start metric. Will also add heartbeat kv.hit_ratio. PoC in 10 days, mitigation in 3 weeks.

eva: Action recap: INF-5120 li - KV counters & warmup (10d PoC), INF-5121 derek - autoscaler RFC+canary (7d), INF-5122 jun - cross-region smoothing (8bd). I'll schedule a 2-week checkpoint and add these to the recurring-patterns epic.

ops-bot: reminder-bot scheduled a follow-up checkpoint in #incidents in 14 days for thread 2135678901

eva: Please update tickets with PRs/tests and ping if blocked. We'll validate success by looking for >=50% recurrence reduction over the next 30 days. Closing until checkpoint. :white_check_mark:
